Like all [[mithril weapons]], it requires 20 [[Attack]] to wield, and is exclusively used in [[melee]] combat. Players can make a mithril mace with the [[Smithing]] skill at level 52 by using a [[mithril bar]] on an [[anvil]] with a [[hammer]] in their inventory, giving the player 50 Smithing experience.
